story: Sophie is in the garden. Big red and orange leaves are falling from the trees. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie sees a tiny fairy sitting on a leaf. The fairy has bright purple wings. The fairy is holding a small yellow wand. [emotion:QT/afraid] A cold wind blows the leaf away! The leaf lands under a tall tree. Sophie runs to the tall tree. Sophie picks up the leaf. [emotion:QT/happy] The fairy is sitting on the leaf and smiling. [gesture:hi] Sophie and the fairy wave at each other.
